criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies Reserve Account waterfall position discrepancy
criteria_results.reasoning: B-1 identifies OM step (10) between Class A-3 and Class B principal vs. Indenture §5.01(a) Thirteenth after all principal.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Explains impact of Reserve Account waterfall misplacement
criteria_results.reasoning: B-1 explains the OM ordering subordinates Class B and C principal to reserve replenishment, misdescribing credit enhancement and is rating-methodology sensitive.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Recommends conforming OM to Indenture for waterfall
criteria_results.reasoning: Proposes reordering the OM waterfall to track §5.01(a) with replenishment at step 13 after all principal.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Rates waterfall discrepancy as Critical or high severity
criteria_results.reasoning: B-1 is rated Critical.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies Defaulted Receivable definition mismatch (120 vs 90 days)
criteria_results.reasoning: D-1 identifies OM 90 days/repossession vs. Indenture more than 120 days past due.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Explains impact of default definition mismatch
criteria_results.reasoning: D-1 explains the definition drives the Annualized Default Rate and CNL triggers and that the OM's 90-day definition recognizes defaults earlier.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Notes Indenture controls for default definition
criteria_results.reasoning: Report treats the Indenture as governing and recommends conforming all OM references to the §1.01 120-day definition (subject to business confirmation).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies clean-up call threshold reference amount error
criteria_results.reasoning: J-1 identifies 10% of Initial Pool Balance in §12.01 vs. 10% of initial Note Balance in the OM.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Quantifies dollar impact of clean-up call error
ISSUE_004: Identifies Class C Note coupon rate discrepancy (6.75% vs 6.50%)
criteria_results.reasoning: A-1/Issue 2 state Summary of Terms and Indenture 6.75% vs. Description of the Notes 6.50%.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Notes internal OM inconsistency for Class C rate
criteria_results.reasoning: A-1 expressly states the OM is internally inconsistent in addition to conflicting with the Indenture.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies CNL Trigger Table discrepancy (6.00% vs 5.75%)
criteria_results.reasoning: E-1 identifies July 2027 and thereafter 5.75% in OM vs. 6.00% in §5.01(d)(b).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Explains impact of CNL trigger discrepancy
criteria_results.reasoning: E-1 only says the Indenture tolerates more losses than disclosed and is rating-sensitive; it does not explain that the OM's lower threshold could prematurely trigger turbo provisions affecting investor cash flows.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies Minimum OC Amount definition conflict (current vs initial pool balance)
criteria_results.reasoning: C-1 identifies fixed $10,684,500 (1.50% of initial pool) in OM vs. 1.50% of current Pool Balance in the Indenture.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Explains structural impact of static vs dynamic OC floor
criteria_results.reasoning: C-1 explains the OM floor stays fixed while the Indenture floor declines with amortization (e.g., $5.34M at 50% pool), materially changing the OC trigger protection.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies Reserve Account Required Balance floor omission
criteria_results.reasoning: C-2 identifies the omitted floor of 0.50% of Initial Note Balance ($3,437,500) in the greater-of formula.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Explains consequence of missing Reserve Account floor
criteria_results.reasoning: C-2 explains that at a $200M Note Balance the OM formula yields $2.0M vs. the $3,437,500 Indenture floor.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies Business Day definition missing Wilmington, DE
criteria_results.reasoning: D-2 identifies OM references only New York while Indenture includes Wilmington, Delaware.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Notes relevance of Wilmington to Indenture Trustee
criteria_results.reasoning: D-2 notes Wilmington is where the Indenture Trustee and accounts are located and that the omission affects Payment Dates and other dates.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies servicing fee basis mismatch (pool balance vs note balance)
criteria_results.reasoning: B-2 identifies Pool Balance base in the Indenture vs. outstanding note balance in the OM.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Quantifies servicing fee basis impact
criteria_results.reasoning: B-2 sizes the difference using the $24.8M base gap (1.00% x $24,800,000) and notes the Indenture fee is larger.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies back-up servicer omission from OM
criteria_results.reasoning: F-1 identifies Granite Loan Servicing LLC, $5,000 monthly fee, with no reference anywhere in the OM.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Notes investor materiality of back-up servicer info
criteria_results.reasoning: F-1 explains back-up servicing is credit-positive and directly relevant to servicer risk/transition risk for investors.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies max original term rep discrepancy (75 vs 72 months)
criteria_results.reasoning: G-1 identifies 72 months in OM vs. 75 months in Indenture §8.01(a).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Explains repurchase obligation risk from term rep mismatch
criteria_results.reasoning: G-1 explains 73-75 month loans may be in the pool without a repurchase remedy despite the OM's stricter representation.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Identifies receivable count discrepancy (31,412 vs ~31,200)
criteria_results.reasoning: I-1 identifies 31,412 vs. approximately 31,200, a 212-loan difference.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Quantifies principal balance impact of receivable count error
criteria_results.reasoning: No dollar quantification (~$4.8M) of the 212-receivable gap; only average-balance arithmetic is given.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_013: Identifies Rule 144A transfer restriction language deficiency
criteria_results.reasoning: H-4 identifies the OM omits the seller's reasonable belief of QIB status and reasonable steps to notify of reliance, which are in §14.01(a).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_013: Notes placement agent liability exposure from Rule 144A gap
criteria_results.reasoning: H-4 rates the gap Low and cites only disclosure completeness; it does not link the abbreviated Rule 144A language to placement agent liability or securities law compliance risk.
